title: Remove mutable metadata from committed documentation
context: Record-count statistics in 5 committed docs files drifted twice in same session when regenerated by different tools (global MCP server vs in-tree CLI). Same fix applied twice, indicating systemic sync problem.
decision: Removed embedded record counts ("240 decisions, 2 bugs, ...") from static documentation; redirect users to hunch_* MCP tools for live, authoritative tallies instead.
consequences: Docs are no longer self-contained; counts are tool-dependent
Eliminates regeneration sync cycles and drift risk
Single source of truth (MCP tools) replaces multiple generator paths
alternatives_rejected: Regenerate more carefully each time (rejected: already tried twice in this session, same problem recurred)
Unify on single canonical generator (rejected: added complexity; MCP tools already serve this purpose)
Automate stat injection via CI (rejected: adds coupling between build system and doc freshness)
